scope: Client-only recovery target confirmation; no consensus, protobuf, gas, delay or on-chain state changes
finding: C-1: an internally consistent recovery bundle could substitute the new signing public key without a readable target fingerprint or independent target check
changes: sign-recovery-bundle requires exactly one trusted local ML-DSA public-key record or full SHA-256 fingerprint
Missing, malformed or mismatched targets reject before loading the recovery signer; --yes cannot bypass the check
Confirmation and result JSON show the algorithm and full fingerprint derived from the validated transaction
create-key-proof validates canonical owner addresses and outputs the public-key fingerprint
Added SignRecoverySignBundleForTarget for untrusted-bundle integrations; existing low-level signing primitives explicitly require caller-established intent
Documented independent trusted target sourcing, key reuse and non-atomic cancellation/rotation response
Added mandatory release-test gates for target substitution and owner validation

validation.substitution_regression: Rebuilt transaction and sign document, recalculated both hashes, supplied and independently verified a genuine attacker-key PoP; target-aware signing refused before the recovery signer was called
validation.cli_regressions: Missing/short/nonhex/mismatched fingerprints, missing/wrong-algorithm/mismatched local keys, conflicting flags; checked with and without --yes; trusted watch-only key and fingerprint positive paths

limits: 794 counts parent and subtest pass events, not independent security properties
The substitution regression is a client test, not an end-to-end chain takeover experiment
The expected target must come from a trusted independent source; copying it from the incoming bundle defeats intent checking
Matching the key does not replace reviewing the owner, network, fee and other transaction intent
Low-level SignRecoverySignBundle and its private-key wrapper remain available for already trusted transaction callers
No new network capacity, four-validator, mainnet snapshot or public-chain run in this client-only change
Local validation is not a GitHub CI result
